caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular glass case with a peaked, transparent roof composed of multiple glass panels framed in blue and beige. Each panel is bordered with blue and tan lines and decorated with small red and pink flowers and leaf motifs, both on the vertical supports and along the horizontal edges. Inside the glass case, there is a human figure lying down on a bed or platform, covered partially by a yellow and brown blanket. The figure’s head is detailed with visible facial features, and the head rests on a yellow pillow with an edge of blue and white patterning. The base of the glass case features additional floral decorative elements in shades of pink, brown, blue, and white. The colors used throughout the drawing include blue, pink, red, brown, yellow, beige, and white. The case is illustrated in a perspective view that allows both the front and roof to be seen simultaneously, and the interior with the figure is clearly visible through the glass. The number "4" is written in the bottom left corner of the drawing.
title: Plate 4: Christ in Sepulchre: From Portfolio "Spanish Colonial Designs of New Mexico"
